limits: All probabilities concern presence admission only, not correct-bit reception.
Independent H1 Monte Carlo validates numerical ideal-model predictions, not sampled physical waveforms.
The .22dB energy derating is hypothetical; no stochastic OU CFO-mismatch bound is claimed.
Target-fit confidence intervals are descriptive; separate validation uses an independent seed.
